seo.title: Lumière | Savor the Moment
seo.description: Discover ice-cold draft beers, signature cocktails, and seasonal pub bites prepared with locally sourced ingredients at Lumière.

hero.description: A seasonal menu inspired by locally sourced ingredients, thoughtfully prepared and beautifully served.

ourStory.subtitle: OUR STORY
paragraphs: At Lumière we believe a drink and meal can tell much more than a recipe.
It all starts with a traditional approach handed down from generation to generation. A simple, delicate, and carefully crafted preparation inspired by authentic pub culture.
That original recipe is the heart of LUMIÈRE.

slides: We reinterpret traditions with modern touches. Discover our signature drinks prepared by blending classics with creativity.
Enjoy the natural freshness of ice-cold cocktails and drinks made with fresh fruits sourced from local producers.
Witness how specialty hops and malts turn into fresh draft perfection in the hands of our master brewers.
Our signature craft beers with intense aromas and rich flavor profiles, served in custom glassware, await you.

testimonials.name: Ayşe Yılmaz
testimonials.note: It was the best beer I've ever had. The bartender was super friendly and welcoming.

testimonials.name: Mehmet Demir
testimonials.note: The beer feels truly 'premium'. The interior design is very cozy, though it gets a bit crowded.

testimonials.name: Zeynep Kaya
testimonials.note: The draft beers were freshly poured, ice-cold, and crisp. Lumière became an essential spot for my evening ritual.

testimonials.name: Can Özkan
testimonials.note: The craft beer bottle design is very stylish and tasted great, but prices could be a bit more affordable.

menu.description: Ice-cold craft beers fresh from the tap. Handcrafted signature cocktails paired with delicious hot pub bites.

products.name: CLASSIC LAGER
products.description: A light-bodied, refreshing, golden classic beer. A pub essential, served ice-cold.

products.name: SIGNATURE CRAFT IPA
products.description: A bold craft beer with rich hop aromas and fruity notes. Perfect for those seeking a characterful flavor.

products.name: WHEAT BEER
products.description: A hazy, full-bodied German-style bottled beer with notes of banana and clove. Smooth on the palate.

products.name: LOADED SNACK PLATTER
products.description: Crispy onion rings, sausage bites, mozzarella sticks, and French fries. Perfect for sharing with groups.

products.name: SAUSAGE PLATTER
products.description: Served with specialty spiced pub sausages, German mustard, and freshly baked bread slices.

products.name: PUB BURGER
products.description: 180g handmade beef patty, caramelized onions, cheddar cheese, and signature pub sauce. Served with crispy fries.

products.name: FISH & CHIPS
products.description: Fresh cod fried in beer batter, served with crispy French fries and tartar sauce.

products.name: NEGRONI
products.description: A balanced mix of gin, Campari, and sweet vermouth. A classic aperitif garnished with an orange peel.
